approach.method_basis: The Parent breeds fresh molecular graphs from its accepted-score population and chooses which ones to evaluate through correlated function draws. Its predictor uses count-fingerprint similarity and fits a monotone unit-linear, three-tanh response transformation to the session's accepted labels. It inverts the latent draws, recenters each candidate's warped residual law at the original raw-score GP mean, and keeps the original warped expectation as the ranking used to restrict stalled batches. The location change has a complete conditional endpoint gain, but its residual amplitudes still come from the inverse warp and its intervals remain narrower than the original GP reference.
approach.novelty: Replace only the residual amplitude consumed by the allocator with the original GP marginal standard deviation. Keep each candidate's standardized warped shape, shared latent draws, raw-score GP location and warped-mean eligibility. This is an amplitude-source test on the complete translated host: it neither fits another signal parameter nor changes the likelihood or gate. Earlier native-quantile amplitude experiments provide a construction precedent and a failed transfer, so their benefit is not assumed here. The test asks whether this one substitution changes actual purchases and improves the complete endpoint panel.

hypothesis: Modify only the amplitude source within the frozen accepted-only inverse-law consumer. At each actual current pool, retain the original fitted nine-coefficient map, original accepted archive/normalization, latent means, original successful jittered factor F and original normal block Z. Let W_i be the unshifted inverse-warp draw, mW_i and dW_i its inherited 128-point quadrature mean and SD in raw-score units, mu_i the already active original raw-GP mean, and dG_i=score_scale*sqrt(sum_j F_ij^2) over every factor column. Compute r_i=dG_i/dW_i and consume A_i=mu_i+r_i*(W_i-mW_i). For every original marginal quantile and median consume QA_i(tau)=mu_i+r_i*(QW_i(tau)-mW_i) and medianA_i=mu_i+r_i*(medianW_i-mW_i), with declared active mean mu_i and active SD dG_i. These are moments under the inherited numerical quadrature definition, not asserted exact analytic integrals. Positive per-coordinate scaling preserves standardized centered inverse-law shape and the common latent dependence construction, while rescaling raw marginal variances and covariance; it does not Gaussianize, refit, or learn a calibration multiplier. Original mW_i still alone controls the unchanged K=3/M=40 eligibility ranking. The inherited sequential sampled maxima, private without-replacement availability and ascending pool-index ties consume A. The path is amplitude replacement -> strict changed real purchased identities -> actual accepted-fit/survival/breeding use -> a conditional endpoint delta. Predict complete correct material purchase exposure and macro delta >=0.002 over n-d17e2a492177. No retained shape/residual benefit, predictive mediator, sibling additivity or transferred donor success is assumed.

finding_summary.headline: GP amplitude changed purchases and improved predictive intervals, but refuted the conditional endpoint target.
finding_summary.insights: Better marginal predictive spread did not establish useful allocation on this host. Full positive gain over actual generating parents fell from 14.04774 to 13.38479, although late-half gain rose from 3.45342 to 3.54598; late incumbent progress fell from 0.86080 to 0.72662. Only 29 of 496 amplitude-only purchases beat their actual generating parents, despite 480 entering the next fit,328 surviving their batch and 152 later being bred. This shows an executed feedback path with limited realized utility, not a causal account of the endpoint loss. The inherited inverse-moment literature element operated, but it supplies no efficacy guarantee for the hybrid allocation law. The molecular report also shows more fragment-sized and very large outputs, recurrent leading scaffold families, and absent stereochemical specification despite many potentially stereogenic graphs. These measurements identify limitations in converting predictive spread into useful purchases and in proposal coverage/control; a different allocation utility or proposal/search scheme would need a separate capability test. This result selects no replacement, establishes no chemical or biological cause, and leaves retained-component contributions, other hosts and population reliability open.
finding_summary.results: All 435 original fits and 4350 prospective four-law predictions completed with no numerical fallback or preservation violation. The change altered 196 purchased sets and introduced 496 actual-only purchases, including 491 certified material choice reversals. All 4350 real labels joined feedback;4200 entered the next fit and 150 final-batch observations were right-censored. Same-paid pinball improved from 0.021727 for the translated reference to 0.021342, and 90% coverage rose from 66.76% to 70.55%. Nevertheless the endpoint macro fell from 0.577516 to 0.553928, a paired loss of 0.023588 against the registered +0.002 target. All three seed macros fell and ten of 15 task/seed endpoints worsened; the loss was concentrated in one task. The Child also remains 0.053102 below the separate formal comparator. Current protocol task-safety thresholds/results were not issued, and the different code Parent makes the literal formal-goal criterion inapplicable.

molecular.headline: Ring-rich families coexist with larger growth and fragment tails, unusual linkages, and absent stereochemical specification.
molecular.overall_character: This assessment concerns only n-a0efadeca943 against its exact code Parent n-d17e2a492177. All five issued tasks and Search seeds 0, 1, 2 have complete accepted trajectories for both nodes: 300 records per cell, comprising ten initial and 290 optimizer records. Each node contributes 4,350 optimizer occurrences and 150 initial occurrences; repeated identities across independent sessions are retained. All 9,000 structures parse with RDKit 2023.09.6. The six supplied summaries agree with trajectory counts and observed maxima. The original request separately reports child_complete=true and paired_complete=true, matched seeds [0,1,2], no profile mismatches and no tasks without trajectories. No requested trajectory or summary is missing. This is chemical record and pairing completeness, not an activation or eligibility judgement. The Child optimizer records contain rings in 4,221/4,350 and aromatic atoms in 4,203/4,350. Aryl amides, fused aza-aromatics, carbonyl/imine heterocycles, open-chain amines and amines in ring frameworks are demonstrated capabilities. The median heavy-atom count is 29 versus Parent 28, but both tails expand: 120 versus 70 records have at most five heavy atoms, and 144 versus 85 have fewer than ten. Strictly above 40/50/60 heavy atoms, counts are 388/201/48 versus 116/40/13. Maximum size is 114 versus 96 heavy atoms; molecular weight exceeds 500 in 957 versus 524 occurrences. These thresholds retain the accepted Parent definitions and are descriptions, not size rewards or chemical filters. The large tail is strongly cell-dependent: one cell alone contains 241 of the Child 388 records above 40 heavy atoms. No optimizer record specifies an atom chiral tag or double-bond stereochemistry. Potential unassigned atom centres occur in 2,279 Child versus 2,247 Parent records; the initial sets already include 75 such occurrences per node, retained separately. All optimizer graphs have zero charged atoms, which does not determine solution protonation or exclude ionizable nitrogens. N-halogen, O-halogen and N-O single-bond connectivity occurs in 723/330/466 Child records versus 654/348/330 Parent. These graph flags identify structures for case-specific scrutiny and do not establish instability, synthetic impossibility or biological effects. Many topology identities coexist with recurrent local families. Accepted SMILES, descriptor ranges and objective values do not demonstrate synthesis, binding, selectivity or developability. All structural counts are RDKit-derived accepted-record measurements, distinct from the digest string counters. Initial, optimizer, per-cell highest/lowest-30 and pooled per-task highest/lowest-30 subsets remain separate. Highest-30 uses existing score descending, then seed and evaluation ascending for ties; lowest-30 reverses score order only. These retrospective subsets are descriptive and not independent replicates. Typed Murcko and generic Murcko scaffolds exclude empty scaffolds and retain their nonempty-record denominators. Similarity is mean binary radius-2, 2048-bit, includeChirality=True Morgan Tanimoto over every distinct record pair within one task after excluding records with fewer than ten heavy atoms; cross-seed repeated molecules remain and no between-task pairs enter. Pooled similarity weights pairs, not seeds; it is not the optimizer count kernel. No definition or denominator differs from the accepted Parent audit: independent recomputation exactly reproduces all 20 pooled and 60 per-cell Parent subset summaries. No new objective call, predictive-model evaluation or medicinal-chemistry score was made. Authority: policy/requests/r0070-03-improve-L01-molecular-assess-7fb3ed7aa3a462ec.json. Accepted Parent report and definitions: nodes/n-d17e2a492177/molecular.json and policy/scratch/r0069-02-improve-L01/molecular-assess-v2/source-audit.json. method_name: Mol GA: rank-selected de novo graph evolution
method_thesis: Anchor the root in Mol GA: maintain a population of oracle-evaluated molecular graphs, sample breeding parents across high-ranked quantiles, generate new offspring through graph crossover and atom/bond mutations, and update survivors greedily after each observation. These are the proposal and selection mechanisms described by [Tripp and Hernández-Lobato (2023)](https://arxiv.org/html/2310.09267v1). Start from the supplied initial observations and incorporate newly evaluated offspring immediately, following the evaluator's announced batching. Repeated graph edits and recombination create an evolving search space; no corpus ranking, stored molecule library, pretrained model, or fixed candidate enumeration is needed. The causal hypothesis is that direct selection on task-local scores concentrates successive structural changes around improving molecules quickly enough to raise the final best observed score. The published evidence concerns a larger-budget AUC-Top-10 setting, so its transfer to this benchmark's final Top-1 objective remains a hypothesis.
